cityItineraries.tours/varanasi-tour-in-one-day/index.htm:
Your private journey

Your itinerary

Day 01

Sunrise, sacred Kashi & evening Aarti

Begin with a private sunrise boat ride, then walk through the old city to the Kashi Vishwanath area. After breakfast, explore selected city temples and Sarnath. Finish with Ganga Aarti and return to your hotel or continue to your departure transfer. Boat operation, temple access and timings are subject to local conditions.

View timings and practical details
05:30 AM

Hotel pickup & drive to the river

Meet your private guide. The exact pickup moves slightly with the season so that the boat starts close to first light.

06:00–07:15 AM

Private sunrise boat ride & ghats

Travel along the Ganges as the city wakes, seeing morning rituals and the changing light on the riverfront. Boat operation remains subject to river and administration conditions.

07:15–08:30 AM

Old City walk & Kashi Vishwanath area

Continue on foot through selected lanes towards the Kashi Vishwanath area. Temple entry is planned according to nationality, eligibility, prevailing security procedures and crowd conditions.

08:30–09:30 AM

Breakfast break

Return to the hotel or pause for breakfast before the second part of the day.

10:00 AM–12:15 PM

Sacred & cultural Varanasi

Visit Sankat Mochan Temple, Tulsi Manas Temple, BHU & New Vishwanath Temple and Bharat Mata Temple, adjusting the sequence for traffic and temple opening hours.

12:15–01:15 PM

Lunch / short rest

A proper break makes the afternoon and evening much more enjoyable, especially after the early start.

01:30–04:15 PM

Sarnath

Explore Chaukhandi Stupa, Dhamek Stupa, the archaeological complex and Mulagandha Kuti Vihara. The Archaeological Museum is included when open; it is closed on Fridays.

04:15–05:15 PM

Return towards central Varanasi

Drive back and reposition for the evening riverfront, with timing adjusted for traffic controls.

05:15/05:30 PM onwards

Evening Ganga Aarti

Walk to the riverfront for the ceremony from the viewing arrangement selected for your tour. Seasonal Aarti timing changes, so we confirm the reporting time locally.

After Aarti

Hotel return or Varanasi departure transfer

Meet the vehicle at the practical pickup point. Return to your hotel, or when your onward flight or train is scheduled the same evening, continue by private transfer to Varanasi Airport or Varanasi Railway Station.

Times are indicative. Sunrise, Aarti timing, temple crowds, river conditions and traffic restrictions change seasonally. Your guide may adjust the sequence to give you a better experience.
cityItineraries.tours/varanasi-tour-in-two-days/index.ht:
Your private journey

Your itinerary

Day 01

Arrival, old-city lanes & Ganga Aarti

Arrive in Varanasi and transfer to your hotel. Meet your guide for an introduction to the old-city lanes and riverfront, then attend evening Ganga Aarti from your agreed viewing arrangement. Return to your hotel after the ceremony.

View day details
DAY 01

Arrival — Old City Introduction & Evening Ganga Aarti

Arrive at Varanasi Airport or Varanasi Railway Station and transfer privately to your hotel. After time to settle, meet your guide for an easy introduction to the old city and riverfront. Walk through selected bazaar lanes before approaching Dashashwamedh Ghat for the evening ceremony. Our preferred arrangement is an elevated balcony viewpoint, which gives a clear view of the complete formation of priests, or Sankalp Aarti participation for guests who want to sit closer and take part in the ritual. Reserved chair seating is a useful comfort option. Boat viewing is arranged only when specifically preferred because boats can be farther from the priests and views can be blocked by other boats.

Sightseeing: Northern Bazaar / old-city lanes, Dashashwamedh Ghat and evening Ganga Aarti by balcony, Sankalp participation or reserved seating according to preference and availability

Overnight: Varanasi

Day 02

Sunrise, Kashi Vishwanath & Sarnath

Take a private sunrise boat ride, followed by the old-city markets and Kashi Vishwanath. After breakfast and rest, explore selected city temples and Sarnath, time permitting. Your private departure transfer follows your flight or train schedule. Boat operation and temple access remain subject to local conditions.

View day details
DAY 02

Sunrise Boat — Manikarnika — Chowk Markets — Kashi Vishwanath — Sarnath — Departure

Leave before sunrise for a private motor-boat ride of around one hour on the Ganges. Continue towards Manikarnika Ghat, where your guide explains Varanasi's beliefs around death and liberation sensitively; this section is optional and is omitted for guests who do not wish to experience the cremation area. Continue on foot through the Chowk flower market, traditional perfume market and Kachori Gali before reaching the Kashi Vishwanath Temple area. Optional assisted priority / Sugam-style darshan can be arranged where the official facility and temple procedures permit. Walk back to the agreed vehicle point and return to the hotel for breakfast and rest.

Later visit selected cultural sights such as Sankat Mochan Temple, Tulsi Manas Temple, BHU & New Vishwanath Temple before driving to Sarnath. Visit Dhamek Stupa, Chaukhandi Stupa and Mulagandha Kuti Vihara; the Archaeological Museum is included when open. After sightseeing, return to Varanasi and proceed by private vehicle to Varanasi Airport or Varanasi Railway Station according to your onward flight or train timing. If your departure is the following day, return to the hotel instead.

Sightseeing: Private sunrise motor boat, Manikarnika Ghat optional, Chowk flower market, perfume market, Kachori Gali, Kashi Vishwanath, Sankat Mochan, Tulsi Manas, BHU & New Vishwanath Temple, Dhamek Stupa, Chaukhandi Stupa and Mulagandha Kuti Vihara

Departure: Private transfer to Varanasi Airport / Railway Station according to schedule
Your private journey

Your itinerary

Day 01

Arrival & evening Ganga Aarti

Transfer to your hotel on arrival, with time to settle in. Meet your guide for an introduction to the riverfront and attend evening Ganga Aarti from the viewing arrangement agreed for your tour.

View day details
DAY 01

Arrival — Old City & Evening Ganga Aarti

Arrive at Varanasi Airport or Varanasi Railway Station and transfer privately to your hotel. After check-in and some rest, meet your guide for a gentle introduction to the old city. Walk through selected market and neighbourhood lanes before approaching the river. For the evening Ganga Aarti, our preferred arrangement is an elevated balcony for the clearest full view of the ceremony or Sankalp participation for travellers who want to sit closer and take part. Reserved chair seating can be used for comfort. Boat viewing is arranged mainly when a guest specifically wants the river perspective because the priests are usually farther away and other boats can obstruct the sightline.

Sightseeing: Northern Bazaar, selected old-city lanes, Dashashwamedh Ghat and evening Ganga Aarti by balcony, Sankalp participation or reserved seating

Overnight: Varanasi

Day 02

Sunrise & the living city

Begin with a private sunrise boat ride, subject to river conditions. Explore the old-city lanes and markets, then visit Kashi Vishwanath according to temple entry procedures. After breakfast and rest, continue through Varanasi’s sacred and cultural sights at a comfortable pace.

View day details
DAY 02

Sunrise Boat — Manikarnika — Chowk Markets — Kashi Vishwanath

Start before sunrise with a private motor-boat ride of around one hour. Continue towards Manikarnika Ghat, where the guide can sensitively explain the traditions surrounding cremation and moksha; guests who do not wish to see the cremation area simply bypass this part. Continue on foot through Chowk flower market, the traditional perfume market and Kachori Gali to the Kashi Vishwanath Temple area. Optional assisted priority / Sugam-style darshan is arranged only where the official procedure is operating. Afterwards walk to the agreed vehicle point and return to the hotel for breakfast and rest.

In the later part of the day visit selected sacred and cultural sites including Sankat Mochan, Tulsi Manas Temple, BHU & New Vishwanath Temple and Bharat Mata Temple. This separation keeps the dense old-city morning practical and the later sightseeing comfortable.

Sightseeing: Private sunrise motor boat, optional Manikarnika Ghat, Chowk flower market, perfume market, Kachori Gali, Kashi Vishwanath, Sankat Mochan, Tulsi Manas, BHU & New Vishwanath Temple and Bharat Mata Temple

Overnight: Varanasi

Day 03

Sarnath & departure

Discover Sarnath’s Buddhist monuments, including Dhamek Stupa, Chaukhandi Stupa and Mulagandha Kuti Vihara. Visit the archaeological museum when open. Return to Varanasi for your airport or railway station transfer, adjusting sightseeing to your departure time.

View day details
DAY 03

Sarnath — Deeper Banaras Experience — Departure

Visit Sarnath with enough time for Dhamek Stupa, Chaukhandi Stupa, Mulagandha Kuti Vihara and the archaeological area. Include the Archaeological Museum when open. Subject to your departure timing, use the remaining time for one deeper experience such as a Banarasi weaving / craft visit, a guided food walk, the southern ghats or another cultural experience rather than adding a rushed checklist.

After the final visit, return to your hotel if required to collect luggage and proceed by private vehicle to Varanasi Airport or Varanasi Railway Station for your onward journey. We adjust Day 3 around the actual flight or train timing so the departure transfer remains comfortable.

Sightseeing: Sarnath archaeological and Buddhist sites plus one deeper experience when departure timing permits

Departure: Private transfer to Varanasi Airport / Railway Station
cityItineraries.tours/ayodhya-tour-in-one-day/index.html:
Your private journey

Your itinerary

Day 01

Ram Mandir, temple quarter & Saryu Aarti

Explore Ram Janmabhoomi, Hanuman Garhi, Kanak Bhawan and Dashrath Mahal with your private guide. Pause for lunch, then continue to the riverfront and Ram Ki Paidi for Saryu Aarti as timings permit. Local e-rickshaws and walking connect restricted areas; temple entry follows current procedures.

View timings and practical details
08:00 AM

Hotel pickup

Meet your guide and begin early enough to approach the main temple area before the heaviest part of the day.

08:15–10:30 AM

Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir

Allow proper time for walking, security and darshan. Waiting time can change sharply on weekends, festival dates and auspicious days.

10:45–11:45 AM

Hanuman Garhi

Continue by walking and/or approved local transport depending on current vehicle restrictions.

12:00–12:45 PM

Kanak Bhawan

Visit one of Ayodhya’s most graceful temple complexes and understand its place in the Ramayana tradition.

01:00–02:00 PM

Lunch

Take a proper lunch break before moving towards the more open riverfront side of Ayodhya.

02:15–03:45 PM

Guptar Ghat

Drive towards Guptar Ghat for a quieter riverfront experience and the associated temple complex.

04:00–05:00 PM

Ram Ki Paidi & old Ayodhya riverfront

Walk along Ram Ki Paidi and the Sarayu-side public spaces as the city moves towards evening.

Evening

Sarayu Aarti

Attend the evening Aarti, with reporting time adjusted to the season and local arrangements.

After Aarti

Return to hotel

Meet the vehicle at the practical pickup point and return privately to your hotel.

Private vehicles cannot always reach temple entrances in Ayodhya. Walking and/or local e-rickshaws may be required. Darshan waiting time varies considerably on weekends, festivals and auspicious dates.

cityItineraries.tours/lucknow-tour-in-one-day/index.html:
Your private journey

Your itinerary

Day 01

Nawabi heritage & old Lucknow

Explore Bara Imambara, Rumi Darwaza, Chhota Imambara and the Residency with your private guide. Discover old Lucknow’s streets and craft traditions, with breaks along the way. The route follows opening hours and your interests; optional food experiences can be arranged separately.

View timings and practical details
09:00 AM

Hotel pickup

Meet your private guide and begin in the historic core before the day becomes busier.

09:15–11:00 AM

Bara Imambara & Bhool Bhulaiya

Explore the monumental complex and its architecture with enough time for the maze section where access is operating.

11:00–11:30 AM

Rumi Darwaza & heritage quarter

Continue through the old city landscape for photographs and historical context.

11:30 AM–12:45 PM

Chhota Imambara

Visit the richly decorated complex and understand the Shia heritage of Lucknow.

01:00–02:00 PM

Lunch

Pause for lunch; this can be kept simple or planned around a preferred Awadhi restaurant.

02:15–03:45 PM

British Residency

Walk through the Residency complex and place the events of 1857 in the wider history of the city.

04:00–05:00 PM

La Martiniere / heritage exterior

See La Martiniere and its distinctive architecture as access permits; internal access can vary.

05:15–06:15 PM

Modern Lucknow / selected city sights

Finish with selected city landmarks according to traffic, interests and the day of travel.

06:30 PM onwards · Optional

Old Lucknow food experience

Add an evening food walk or tasting route if you want the day to continue into Lucknow’s culinary side.

Times are indicative. Monument opening, internal access, traffic and local closures can change. We keep the route private and adjust the sequence when that makes the day work better.
